crossRefs.note: Wisdom has built her house. She has carved out her seven pillars.
She has prepared her meat. She has mixed her wine. She has also set her table.
In this mountain, Yahweh of Armies will make all peoples a feast of choice meat, a feast of choice wines, of choice…
He will destroy in this mountain the surface of the covering that covers all peoples, and the veil that is spread over…
They will come and sing in the height of Zion, and will flow to the goodness of Yahweh, to the grain, to the new wine…
Ephraim will be like a mighty man, and their heart will rejoice as through wine; yes, their children will see it, and…
“The Kingdom of Heaven is like a certain king, who made a wedding feast for his son,
I have come into my garden, my sister, my bride. I have gathered my myrrh with my spice; I have eaten my honeycomb with…
“Hey! Come, everyone who thirsts, to the waters! Come, he who has no money, buy, and eat! Yes, come, buy wine and milk…
He said to them, “Go into all the world, and preach the Good News to the whole creation.
He who believes and is baptized will be saved; but he who disbelieves will be condemned.
Behold, I stand at the door and knock. If anyone hears my voice and opens the door, then I will come in to him, and…
